1.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

2.text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

3.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

4.text: So woe to those who pray

5.text: [But] who are heedless of their prayer<sup foot_note="228295">1</sup> -

footnotes.228295: - i.e., the hypocrites who are unconcerned if they miss prayers when no one sees them.

6.text: Those who make show [of their deeds]
